_about: Minimal evidence schema for the future isolated run. Checked by check-package.mjs (hand-rolled, no dependency). Rules: policy LOADED is never PASS for enforcement; evidence_kind MOCK_ENDPOINT or DIRECT_FEED is never presented as real-model evidence; PASS needs evidence_sha256 of an artifact.
export: none defined. Evidence stays in C:\evidence inside the sandbox until the owner chooses a method (see README).
